text: Once metal (and germanium) are on the wafer, all subsequent process steps must stay below about ___ degrees C — the thermal-budget constraint that orders the entire flow (oxidation and LPCVD first, metals and PECVD/ALD last).
explanation: The roughly 400-450 degrees C thermal budget after metallization forces the flow's ordering and explains back-end material quirks such as the N-H absorption overtone near 1520 nm in low-temperature nitride. High-temperature steps (thermal oxidation, LPCVD nitride, implant anneals) must all precede metal deposition.
